mapper.sql: CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_membership um WHERE um.user_id = ph.user_id AND um.status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'MEMBERSHIP' ELSE 'GENERAL' END
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount END), 0) AS totalEarned, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount END)), 0) AS totalUsed, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS totalBalance, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount > 0) AS earnCount FROM point_history

SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS memberCount, COUNT(*) AS earnCount, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS earnedAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(amount)), 0) AS averageEarned, CASE WHEN tier = 'MEMBERSHIP' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END AS ratePercent FROM ( SELECT ph.user_id, ph.amount, AS tier FROM point_history ph WHERE ph.amount > 0 AND ph.description LIKE '구매확정 포인트 적립%' ) t GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier

SELECT ph.point_id AS pointId, ph.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, AS tier, ph.amount, ph.type, ph.description, TO_CHAR(ph.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM point_history ph JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ph.user_id ORDER BY ph.created_at DESC, ph.point_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
